items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Of course there's Sylvia Syms. You remember Sylvia Syms?

ctx.x: Yes. "If I Had A Ribbon Bow," which became very popular for me; "Who Is Sylvia," "Molly Malone" and "Barbara Allen." Now these are all the folk-type things we did with the Kirby treatment. Because Lou Singer was not only doing a little research for me picking up these numbers, he also did the arrangements too.

Yeah. Well fortunately, the 78's may be hard to come by. And again, these I received from the Institute of Jazz Studies. But "If I Had I Ribbon Bow," two versions of that appeared on one playing record recently.
